summary: Master Product-Led Growth Marketing. Learn the AARRR framework, PQL definitions, and experimentation loops to scale your revenue. Enroll today.
lede: Product-led growth marketing connects product experience and behavioral data with acquisition, activation, retention, and revenue growth. Designed for growth marketers, product managers, and lifecycle marketers, the course helps teams diagnose user journeys and prioritize improvements based on product behavior. Learners practise funnel and cohort analysis, onboarding experiments, and lifecycle campaign mapping while developing an activation dashboard and growth experiment backlog.
audienceIntro: Product-Led Growth Marketing training suits professionals who already work with customer journeys, campaign data, product usage, or commercial growth decisions. It is designed for intermediate learners who can contribute to cross-functional planning and want stronger analytical and experimentation capability.
modules: Jobs to Be Done Customer Research
prerequisites: You should have working experience in marketing, product management, customer success, revenue operations, or digital analytics. Familiarity with campaign metrics, customer journeys, or product usage data will help, but advanced statistics and programming are not required. You will use sample datasets and browser-based exercises; bring a laptop if the delivery format supports hands-on dashboard work. Advanced analytics, AI-assisted segmentation, and predictive PQL scoring are covered at operational application level. The course does not require coding or production deployment.
